notes: Open base class with no body beyond the constructor delegating to `IUnknown(arg0)` - the jagdx analogue of the real Direct3D9 `IDirect3DBaseTexture9` COM interface, which itself has no methods beyond those inherited from `IDirect3DResource9`/`IUnknown` (GetType/SetLOD/GetLOD/SetAutoGenFilterType/etc are all omitted here, presumably unused by this renderer). Subclassed by `IDirect3DTexture`, `IDirect3DCubeTexture`, `IDirect3DVolumeTexture` (all in this package) and referenced generically as the parameter type of `IDirect3DDevice.SetTexture(stage, texture: IDirect3DBaseTexture?)`.
